package.name: autobot_manip_planner
package.description: Plans a collision-free pick (approach + grasp + lift) for a tracked object: calls manip/plan_grasp, solves IK at the pre-grasp pose, self-collision-checks it with coal, and runs an OMPL joint-space plan from the current arm configuration to the pre-grasp configuration. Exposed via manip/plan_pick and republished on manip/pick_plan.
